annotations.title: Translate subtitles: SRT or VTT into another language, timings kept

description: Translate an SRT or WebVTT subtitle file into another language cue by cue, keeping every timing and the file format, so the result drops straight into a video player or editor. Up to 400 cues (40,000 characters) as text or by URL; the source language is detected unless given. Meta M2M100 translation, 100 languages. Use to subtitle videos, courses and podcasts in more languages; pair with transcribe_long, which writes the first SRT. Price $0.02/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

from.description: Source language code (default: detected from the text)

subtitles.description: The SRT or VTT text (or give url)

to.description: Target language code such as sv, de, es, fr or ja

url.description: URL of an .srt or .vtt file, instead of subtitles
